title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 57503 Country: India Title: Umrah Question: My question is that after performing Umrah can I perform more Umrahs after doing niyat at Masjid Ayesha (Makkah). Answer ID: 57503 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 332/332/M=04/1436) If you want to perform second umrah after completing the first one then you may proceed for it while wearing Ihram from Masjid Ayesha (Tan’eem). One Ihram can suffice only for one umrah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
